content:
incident-bot: [P1] High GPU queue depth detected in cluster us-west2-spot. Autoscaler failing to provision new spot nodes. Recent preemption spike -> rapid queue growth (tokenization jobs). Affected services: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/spot-fallback

alex: oncall here. Opening incident bridge. Paging SREs. What’s current queue depth and error from autoscaler?

maya: looking. queue_length = 12540 across gpu-pool-us-west2-spot. Autoscaler logs show repeated failures to provision with error "InsufficientCapacity" and occasional quota errors. Snippet:
```
2025-09-18T19:45:02Z autoscaler: LaunchInstance failed: ClientError InsufficientCapacity
2025-09-18T19:45:04Z autoscaler: retrying launch, attempt=3
2025-09-18T19:45:09Z autoscaler: error: quotaExceeded: exceeded GPUs-per-project in region us-west2
```

jon: Confirming — we just hit a regional GPU quota at the cloud provider side. There's also a short-lived AVAILABILITY_ZONE flapping in us-west2-b. Spot pool can't replenish. Fallback policy didn't kick in because fallback pool had max_capacity=0 (whoops).

alex: ouch. @maya @jon immediate actions: 1) open bridge (done) 2) engage dedicated fallback pool 3) throttle background/low-priority jobs 4) notify CS.

samantha: pinged CS. Customer-facing impact: embeddings latency spiked and we’re returning 429s/rate-limited errors for non-enterprise keys. Two customers reported degraded search experience. Tracking in customer-impact doc: https://redwood/incidents/1956789012/cust-impact

maya: trying to patch routing policy to prefer dedicated pool. Running:
```
# switch routing policy to prefer dedicated pool for tail-requests
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  https://api.redwood.dev/v1/routing/policies -d '{"policy":"dedicated-first","target":"dedicated-a","ttl":600}'
```

deploy-bot: config change accepted, applying.

deploy-bot: change applied to routing policy id=rp-98f. Rolling updates: sending 2000 in-flight requests to fallback cluster over next 60s.

jon: also requesting temporary quota bump with cloud provider. Filed request ID: GCP-REQ-892374. If approved, autoscaler can resume adding spot nodes; may take 20-40m.

alex: while we wait, throttle non-critical pipelines. @maya can you flip the background-job rate limiter for embeddings and reranking to 10%?

maya: done.

maya: updated rate-limiter config:
```
service: embeddings
background_percentage: 10
apply: now
```

ops-sre: monitoring metrics — queue depth down to 8.2k after routing change and throttle. Latency for /v1/generate still elevated but not erroring for enterprise keys.

samantha: letting affected accounts know we’ve moved traffic and applied mitigations. ETA for full restoration depends on cloud quota approval or allocation of on-demand GPUs.

lee: product note — disable low-priority evals and large-batch jobs in org-safe-mode. I’m toggling that now.

deploy-bot: org-safe-mode toggled, large-batch jobs cancelled (approx 2k jobs).

jon: alternate mitigation: spin up on-demand reserved nodes in us-east1 into dedicated-a. I can trigger create-reserved with the infra API. Any objections?

alex: do it. Prefer us-east to avoid the regional quota problem. Ensure encryption and network peering checks.

jon:
```
infra-cli reserve create --region=us-east1 --pool=dedicated-a --count=8 --gpu-type=A10G
# monitor: infra-cli reserve status <id>
```

deploy-bot: reserve create accepted id=res-2025-09-18-01. Provisioning expected ~12m.

maya: routing metrics show 28% of traffic already shifted. We'll continue draining spot pool and route new requests to reserved.

ops-sre: alert — autoscaler still failing to create spot instances (quota). But fallback routing + reserve nodes prevented customer-visible errors for enterprise tier. Non-enterprise still sees 429s for embeddings.

samantha: CS update pushed to status page and targeted messages to affected customers. Minimal revenue impact so far; we're tracking closely.

alex: next steps: 1) monitor queue and throttles (ops-sre) 2) follow up on quota request (jon) 3) postmortem action items: ensure fallback pool max_capacity != 0, add automated test for fallback routing, tighten runbook. Assign owners.

maya: creating ticket RN-1959 to fix fallback config and add unit test for routing policy. Also logging temporary commands for post-incident.

jon: cloud quota request approved partially — +4 GPUs for us-west2 in 35m. Combined with reserves in us-east we should be back to normal in ~40m. Monitoring.

ops-sre: queue at 2.1k and falling. Error rate for embeddings down to 1.8% (baseline 0.2%). Continue to monitor 30m.

alex: handing off to night SREs @ops-sre; we'll remain on-call until metrics stabilize. Create follow-up incident for long-term changes.

samantha: will close customer messages once sustained 30m of healthy metrics.

incident-bot: Incident placed in monitoring state. Bridge closed at 2025-09-18T20:22:00Z. Playbook: https://redwood/playbooks/spot-fallback. :white_check_mark:

lee: follow-up items summarized: quota hardening, fallback capacity defaults, autoscaler unit-tests, alert tuning for false positives. Assigning owners in follow-up ticket.

alex: thanks team. Good work. :thumbsup:
